content.text:
**Status:** DONE

**Implemented:**
- `avatar.tsx` — now accepts `image?: string | null` + `size`, renders expo-image circle if image present, else initials (single-name → first 2 chars, multi-name → first+last initials). Font size scaled via `style` — confirmed `themed-text.tsx` spreads `style` last in the array, so it reliably overrides the type's `fontSize`.
- `app-header-left.tsx` — reads session via `authClient.useSession()`, renders user avatar, `useNavigation()` from expo-router + cast to `{ openDrawer?: () => void }` on press (verified `useNavigation` is exported from expo-router).

**Tested:**
- `bun run typecheck` (apps/mobile): zero errors
- `bun oxc` (root): no warnings/errors in the two files (only pre-existing warnings elsewhere)
- Committed as `18fb183c` (only the two files; formatter's tsconfig.json reformat restored to avoid noise)

**Files changed:** `apps/mobile/src/components/avatar.tsx`, `apps/mobile/src/components/app-header-left.tsx`

**Self-review:**
- Avatar handles image + initials + sizes correctly
- Drawer opens via `useNavigation()` cast approach (typechecks; `useNavigation<DrawerNavigationProp>()` variant not needed)
- No unused imports
- expo-image confirmed in package.json dependencies (~57.0.3)

**Concerns:** none.
